quarterly_data.signal: On October 15, 2026 Eikon announced the submission of an Investigational New Drug (IND) application to the U.S. FDA to evaluate EIK1006 for the treatment of advanced metastatic prostate cancer. EIK1006 is an internally-derived, novel androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that is structurally unrelated to currently available lutamide-class antagonists and targets wild-type AR and clinically relevant variants implicated in resistance to conventional prostate cancer therapies. CEO Roger Perlmutter: the submission 'demonstrates once again that Eikon's advanced imaging platform can permit the identification of truly novel, highly potent, drug candidates through the visualization of individual proteins in living cells'; Eikon looks forward to evaluating whether these attributes can translate into meaningful clinical benefit.
